name: Vitre Dock
description: A magnifying glass Dock with window previews, Quick Launch, app folders and more. Vitre Dock is a fork of Dhruva by NarkAgni (https://github.com/narkagni/dhruva, GPL-3.0) with changes for Vitre: it hands window motion over to Vitre, keeps the app on the stage where it is and keeps a window preview open while the Dock redraws.
